OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord
OrderRecord.description: A digital kitchen pass ticket replacing voice orders, tracking takeaway vs dine-in type, spice/sauce modifiers, line-item verification, and peak-hour flag.

ticketNumber.description: Short human-readable ticket code such as #TK-001 or #DI-001.

orderType.description: Channel distinguishing walk-in takeaway, phone takeaway, and dine-in.

tableOrPhone.description: Customer phone/name for takeaway or table number for dine-in.

status.description: Current kitchen pass lifecycle state; completed is terminal.

items.description: Bounded list (1-20) of line items with spice level, sauce option, and packing verification flag.

totalRm.description: Total order price in Malaysian Ringgit (RM).

isPeakHour.description: True if order was logged during the 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM dinner rush.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when order was last updated.

QuickMenuItem.title: QuickMenuItem
QuickMenuItem.description: Top-10 quick-tap menu dish configured by the family restaurant for rapid one-tap counter entry.

isTopTen.description: Whether the item appears in the 10 most common quick-tap items.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when menu item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when menu item was updated.

MistakeLog.title: MistakeLog
MistakeLog.description: Append-only quality & RM 6 cost-impact log recording either a verified pass save (+RM 6 saved) or a reported customer mistake (-RM 6 cost).

orderId.description: Document ID of the associated order in /users/{userId}/orders.

outcome.description: Whether a mistake slipped out or was caught by the digital checklist.

category.description: Specific mistake category from the case study.

isPeakHour.description: Whether the event occurred during the 7-9 PM peak dinner rush.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log entry was created.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Restaurant owner's digital kitchen pass orders.

/users/{userId}/mistake_logs/{logId}.description: Append-only mistake & RM 6 savings audit trail linked to orders.
